_about: Holdings the owner bought by hand in IB and asked the bot to manage. Each line holds what the bot's own entry records - entry = the signal close, stop = the signal's cut-loss - plus hw = the highest close since, and entry_date = the FILL day (the backtest's bars=0-on-fill-day rule; the bot's own 23:35 UTC buys stamp the signal day, one weekday earlier). ib_bot.adopt_holdings seeds each one into state.json once, only while it is held, and never over another instrument. Leave lines in place after adoption: an adopted holding is skipped. See execution/README.md.

adopt.why: Bought by the owner (2 shares at 517.44) at the 2026-10-23 open on the strategy's own 2026-10-22 BUY signal (score 61), which the bot missed while the false kill-switch blocked entries. stop = max(521.08 - 3.5 x ATR14 11.3698, 0.88 x 521.08) = 481.29, from the engine's own atr() on that close. hw = the 2026-10-23 close. Owner asked for it to be managed on 2026-10-23.
